dress.detail: Discotech recommends collared or form-fitting shirts, slacks or jeans, and dress shoes. It says to avoid athletic wear, sneakers, flip-flops, shorts, sweatpants and hats. Another guide says 'smart and elegant' with no shorts, athletic wear or flip-flops. Themed events can override this; one Halloween party required costumes.
